# Free HEIC Converter

> Free online tool to convert HEIC/HEIF images to JPG, PNG, WebP and PDF. No installation, no signup, works entirely in the browser. Files are processed locally on your device, so they never leave your machine.

## Features

- Convert HEIC to JPG, PNG, WebP and PDF
- Batch conversion: process multiple photos at once
- Privacy-friendly: all conversion happens in the browser, nothing is uploaded
- No account, no software, no watermarks

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://heic2any.online/): Main converter tool for HEIC/HEIF images
- [HEIC to JPG](https://heic2any.online/heic-to-jpg): Convert HEIC photos to JPG/JPEG
- [HEIC to PNG](https://heic2any.online/heic-to-png): Convert HEIC photos to PNG
- [HEIC to WebP](https://heic2any.online/heic-to-webp): Convert HEIC photos to WebP
- [HEIC to PDF](https://heic2any.online/heic-to-pdf): Combine one or more HEIC photos into a single PDF
- [Blog](https://heic2any.online/blog/): Guides on opening, understanding and converting HEIC files

## Guides

- [What is HEIC?](https://heic2any.online/blog/what-is-heic): Understand the HEIC/HEIF format and when to convert it
- [HEIC vs JPEG](https://heic2any.online/blog/heic-vs-jpeg): Quality, file size and compatibility compared
- [HEIC vs PNG](https://heic2any.online/blog/heic-vs-png): Lossless vs HEIC and which to pick
- [HEIC vs WebP](https://heic2any.online/blog/heic-vs-webp): Modern web format compared to HEIC
- [Open HEIC on Windows](https://heic2any.online/blog/open-heic-on-windows): View and convert HEIC without a Mac
- [Open HEIC on Mac](https://heic2any.online/blog/open-heic-on-mac): Preview, batch export and shortcuts
- [Open HEIC on Android](https://heic2any.online/blog/open-heic-on-android): Convert HEIC received on Android
- [HEIC to PDF](https://heic2any.online/blog/heic-to-pdf): Turn photos into a single shareable PDF
